versions.name: RXV2-0.9.627-adj-help
versions.notes: In-flight adjustments: the help screen rewritten - clear and short (Malcolm 2026-09-11). Includes 0.9.626.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.626-which-bank
versions.notes: In-flight adjustments: the two bank settings now read 'Which PID bank flies (1 to 4)' and 'Which rates bank flies (1 to 4)'; the help says every other setting is changed in the bank active at the time; switching a line from Knob to Switch prefills the positions (banks 1, 2, 3 in order; other settings spread across the knob's range) - Malcolm 2026-09-11. Includes 0.9.625.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.625-knob-switch
versions.notes: In-flight adjustments: the choice reads just Knob or Switch and the page loses its introduction - what they mean is in the help (Malcolm 2026-09-11: 'keep this page as simple as possible'). Includes 0.9.624.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.624-two-kinds
versions.notes: In-flight adjustments (renamed): two kinds only - a knob for continuous adjustment within a range, or a switch choosing between settings, two or three positions (Malcolm 2026-09-11). A step-type line set in the configurator is shown but left exactly as it is. Includes 0.9.623.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.623-dividers
versions.notes: Adjustments page: a switch is one bar with draggable dividers - one for a two-position switch, two for a three-position one - and a value for each position (Malcolm 2026-09-11: 'three position switches would allow three possible values'). Underneath, one Rotorflight line per position, read back as one row. Knobs keep draggable ends; nudging has a down zone, a dead zone and an up zone. The red line still shows the switch's live position, and the region it is in lights up. Includes 0.9.622.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.622-adjust-bars
versions.notes: Adjustments page: every switch or knob range is a bar you drag by its round ends, with a red line showing the channel's live position that turns green inside the zone - move the switch and watch it (Malcolm 2026-09-11), as on the Modes page. Includes 0.9.621.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.621-adjustments
versions.notes: Adjustments page: the switch positions are now decoded the way Rotorflight stores them (signed 5-microsecond steps around 1500, so 'whole travel' reads 900 to 2100, not 4175), channels are named AUX1 to AUX13 as in Rotorflight, each line says in plain English whether a knob sets the value or a switch nudges it up and down, and the page has a help screen (Malcolm 2026-09-11: 'slightly mysterious'). Includes 0.9.620.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.620-usb-clean
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: Adjustments and the Command line, proven on a Nexus. The 'reply bigger than the link buffer' alarm no longer fires for legitimate USB replies. Includes 0.9.619.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.619-usb-jumbo
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: big replies (255 bytes and more, e.g. the adjustments list) are now parsed in Rotorflight's real jumbo-frame order - size, command, then the 16-bit length. Includes 0.9.618.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.618-usb-breadcrumbs
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: after a crash the boot log says which USB step was running (diagnostic build). Includes 0.9.617.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.617-usb-only-pages
versions.notes: What only USB can do (Malcolm 2026-09-11): a Command line page (every Rotorflight setting by name, with Save and Leave buttons) and an Adjustments page (a knob or switch changing a setting in flight - the 588-byte list the radio link could never carry). Both say plainly that they need the flight controller's USB socket plugged into the dongle when it is not. Factory reset is allowed over USB only. Includes 0.9.616.

versions.name: RXV2-0.9.616-dongle-usb2
versions.notes: Dongle over USB: page requests now get their answers (the waits that pump the UART drain the USB link too). Includes 0.9.615.
